mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.ok.detail: Nothing blocks or slows them down.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.child.detail: They will work once grown up.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.no_job.detail: Hire them from a hut's Workers page, or set a hut to automatic hiring.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.paused.detail: Resume them with the button on their hut's Workers page.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.sick.detail: They don't work until cured: a hospital, or the item they ask for.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.raided.detail: They resume once the raiders are gone.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.mourning.detai: Someone close died: they work less for a while.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.rain.detail: Workers don't work in the rain, unless the university research allows it.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.sleep.detail: Normal at night: they resume in the morning.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.eat.detail: A meal break, they resume afterwards.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.hungry.detail: They work badly on an empty stomach: a restaurant with a menu, or food in their house.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.no_home.detail: They sleep outside and get unhappy: build or upgrade a house.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.unhappy.detail: An unhappy citizen works slower: see the happiness tab.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.crafter_no_ord: A crafter only makes what it is ordered: knowing the recipe is not enough, and neither is having the ingredients in the warehouse. To give it work: request the item at the post box, add it to the minimum stock (warehouse), or start a construction that needs it. If the finished item is already in the warehouse, the warehouse delivers it, not the crafter.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.crafter_no_rec: It knows nothing to make: teach it a recipe from its hut's Recipes tab.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.crafter_disabl: All its recipes are disabled, so it gets no order. Enable one again in its hut's Recipes tab.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.crafter_waitin: It has an order but lacks this ingredient: a courier or another crafter is getting it.
It has an order but lacks this ingredient, and nobody in the colony can provide it: you have to bring it (see the clipboard).
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.crafter_orders: It has what it needs and makes its orders one by one (its hut's Tasks tab).
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.builder_idle.d: Nothing to build: start a construction or an upgrade with a hut's build button.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.builder_next.d: A construction is waiting and it can do it: it will take it on its own shortly.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.builder_manual: It is in manual mode: it takes no construction on its own. Assign it from its hut's "Work orders" page, or switch it to Automatic in its settings.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.builder_far.de: A builder only takes constructions within 100 blocks of its hut (this one is %s blocks away). A closer builder can take it.
Its hut is level %s: a builder does not build higher than its hut's level (except at level 5). Upgrade the builder's hut first.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.builder_player: Nobody in the colony can provide this item for the construction "%s": bring it to its hut (see the clipboard).
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.builder_missin: For "%s", these materials are not in its hut yet: they are requested and come through a courier, a crafter or the warehouse. It builds with what it has and stops when a block is missing. Details on its hut's "Required resources" page.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.builder_site.d: It has everything it needs for this construction.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.courier_idle.d: Nothing to deliver for now: couriers carry items between the warehouse and the huts when someone asks for them.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.courier_busy.d: Too many deliveries for it, huts are waiting: hire one more courier (the warehouse takes more at each level) or build huts closer to the warehouse.
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.says_blocking: They said it: they can't work until it's sorted out (right click them to answer).
mcvanillatweaks.diagnosis.says_important: They said it: it slows them down (right click them to answer).
